text:
D-topia | Launch Trailer
D-topia is AVAILABLE NOW on XBOX Series X|S + Windows.

Welcome to D-topia. As part of the Utopia Project, D-topia was created to maximize human happiness and comfort. Step into a future where happiness is curated by artificial intelligence in this gentle-paced puzzle adventure.

Tackle fun logic-based puzzles to resolve mechanical issues and keep the facilities running smoothly and meet the many vibrant residents, each with their own unique story and personal struggle.

But what happens when problems go beyond the mechanical? How will your choices impact the wellbeing of the residents, and the future of humanity? In a world of curated happiness, what does it mean to find purpose?

Play D-topia Today: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/d-topia/9MZFQBNKLN51

The Alters: Last Variable | Launch Trailer
Jan Scientist's mission continues. 

A roughly 20-hour expansion to the award-winning personal survival game The Alters - available now.

The Oasis - a lush paradise emerging from desolation - becomes Jan's obsession. One he cannot grasp alone. Assemble a crew of specialist alters: Geologist, Biologist, Chemist, Physicist. Together, you'll terraform a hostile planet, build an underground research base, and uncover mysteries that may reshape everything. But can we really understand everything?

The Alters: Last Variable is out now.
